text:
The function $\fn{SubtreeSeq}(t)$, which returns the code of a
  sequence the elements of which are the codes of all subtrees of the
  tree with code~$t$, is primitive recursive.

The functions $f\colon \PosInt \to \PosInt$ and $g \colon \PosInt \to
\PosInt$ given by
\begin{align*}
f(n) & = 2n \text{ and}\\
g(n) & = 2n - 1
\end{align*}
enumerate the even positive integers and the odd positive integers,
respectively. However, neither function is an enumeration of
$\PosInt$, since neither is !!{surjective}.
